blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) on Tuesday released new mugshots of former House Speaker and incumbent Leyte 1st District Rep. Martin Romualdez. Unlike his first mugshots from his arrest, the new mugshots show Romualdez standing while wearing the standard yellow Person Deprived of Liberty (PDL) shirt of the Bureau of Jail Management and Penology (BJMP). Romualdez was transferred to the New Quezon City Jail in Payatas on Monday night upon an order by the Sandiganbayan Third Division.
